name: How do I know if my sliding windows need to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my sliding windows need to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your sliding windows may need replacement. You might notice drafts, condensation between the glass panes, or difficulty opening and closing them. Increased energy bills can also be a strong indicator, as old or damaged windows lose their insulation effectiveness. Visible damage like cracked frames, warped sashes, or rotting wood are clear signs. If your windows are old, especially single-pane models, upgrading to modern, energy-efficient sliding windows can significantly improve comfort and reduce heating and cooling costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, condensation, difficulty operating, increased energy bills, or visible damage like cracks and rot. Old, single-pane windows are also good candidates for replacement.
